notes: Four distinct movable parts are manipulated: two separate overhead cabinet doors and two separate drawers. The overhead doors' closing order is inferred from the sparse samples; the left door likely closes around frame 316 and the right door around frame 324. Open is treated as on and closed as off.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a compact kitchen. After an initial survey, the user opens both doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, opens a food drawer left of the oven, closes the overhead doors, opens a utility drawer right of the oven, and later closes both drawers.
